summary: Replaced the process-wide settings with an immutable Settings value, settings.make() and an explicit conf parameter on every function that needs a setting. Import-time reads and caches (units, dim divisor, closed days, freight minimum, fuel factor, zone table, fx factors) now follow the conf passed in, and the quote cache is keyed by equal settings. The tests are moved to the new API and all 73 pass. About 450 randomized CLI runs and 120 library runs matched the original package byte for byte.
